# `alerce_tap` column dictionary

All 725 columns of the 31 tables with type, unit and description, generated from the alerce_tap Schema Explorer ([artifact](https://claude.ai/artifact/JEpEyijsTpD1y83ut7Zia7); TAP metadata of 2026-11-19). **Search this file (grep) instead of reading it whole.** Flags: PK = primary key, IDX = database index, TAP = flagged indexed in TAP_SCHEMA. For keys, joins and fast filters see `indexes-and-joins.md`.

## object

This table contains aggregated information about astronomical objects observed in multiple surveys. Each record corresponds to a unique object identified by its position and survey. The table includes astrometric properties (mean RA/Dec), detection statistics (number of detections, forced photometry measurements, non-detections), and temporal coverage (first and last observation dates).

| column | type | unit | flags | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `oid` | long |  | PK TAP | Internal object identifier |
| `tid` | short |  |  | Telescope identifier |
| `sid` | short |  | PK IDX TAP | Survey identifier |
| `meanra` | double | deg | IDX TAP | Mean right ascension (ICRS) |
| `meandec` | double | deg | IDX TAP | Mean declination (ICRS) |
| `sigmara` | double | deg |  | Standard deviation of right ascension |
| `sigmadec` | double | deg |  | Standard deviation of declination |
| `firstmjd` | double | d | IDX TAP | First observation MJD |
| `lastmjd` | double | d | IDX TAP | Last observation MJD |
| `deltamjd` | double | d |  | Time span between first and last observation |
| `n_det` | int |  | IDX TAP | Number of detections |
| `n_forced` | int |  |  | Number of forced photometry measurements |
| `n_non_det` | int |  |  | Number of non-detections |
| `created_date` | char[*] |  |  | Date when the record was created |
| `updated_date` | char[*] |  |  | Date when the record was last updated |

## ztf_object

ZTF-specific properties for astronomical objects including color indices, stellar classification, photometric correction flags, and historical detection statistics from the Zwicky Transient Facility survey.

| column | type | unit | flags | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `oid` | long |  | PK TAP | Unique identifier for this object |
| `g_r_max` | float |  |  | Maximum g-r color (difference between minimum g and r band magnitudes) |
| `g_r_max_corr` | float |  |  | Maximum g-r color using corrected magnitudes |
| `g_r_mean` | float |  |  | Mean g-r color (difference between mean g and r band magnitudes) |
| `g_r_mean_corr` | float |  |  | Mean g-r color using corrected magnitudes |
| `corrected` | boolean |  |  | Whether the corrected light curve was computed and can be used |
| `stellar` | boolean |  |  | Whether the object is likely a stellar-like (unresolved) source based on PS1 and ZTF reference image properties |
| `reference_change` | boolean |  |  | Reference image change flag indicating template update |
| `diffpos` | boolean |  |  | Difference image positivity flag |
| `ndethist` | int |  |  | Number of spatially-coincident detections within 1.5 arcsec going back to beginning of survey; only detections on the same field and readout-channel ID are counted, down to S/N ~ 3 |
| `ncovhist` | int |  |  | Number of times the object position fell on any field and readout-channel going back to beginning of survey |
| `mjdstarthist` | double | d |  | Earliest Modified Julian Date corresponding to ndethist |
| `mjdendhist` | double | d |  | Latest Modified Julian Date corresponding to ndethist |
| `created_date` | char[*] |  |  | Date record was created |

## ztf_detection

Individual detections from ZTF difference imaging, including PSF and aperture photometry, Real/Bogus quality scores, corrected magnitudes accounting for reference flux, and flags indicating image quality and photometric reliability.

| column | type | unit | flags | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `oid` | long |  | PK IDX TAP | Unique identifier for this object |
| `measurement_id` | long |  | PK TAP | Unique identifier for the subtraction candidate (candid from ZTF) |
| `pid` | long |  |  | Processing ID for image |
| `diffmaglim` | float | mag |  | 5-sigma magnitude limit in difference image based on PSF-fit photometry |
| `isdiffpos` | int |  |  | Difference image sign: 1 => candidate is from positive (science minus reference) subtraction; -1 => candidate is from negative (reference minus science) subtraction |
| `nid` | int |  |  | Night ID |
| `magpsf` | float | mag |  | Magnitude from PSF-fit photometry |
| `sigmapsf` | float | mag |  | 1-sigma uncertainty in magpsf |
| `magap` | float | mag |  | Aperture magnitude using 8 pixel diameter aperture |
| `sigmagap` | float | mag |  | 1-sigma uncertainty in magap |
| `distnr` | float | arcsec |  | Distance to nearest source in reference image PSF-catalog within 30 arcsec |
| `rb` | float |  |  | RealBogus quality score from machine learning classifier, range 0 to 1 where closer to 1 is more reliable |
| `rbversion` | char[*] |  |  | Version of RealBogus model/classifier used to assign rb quality score |
| `drb` | float |  |  | RealBogus quality score from Deep-Learning-based classifier, range 0 to 1 where closer to 1 is more reliable |
| `drbversion` | char[*] |  |  | Version of Deep-Learning-based classifier model used to assign drb quality score |
| `magapbig` | float | mag |  | Aperture magnitude using 18 pixel diameter aperture |
| `sigmagapbig` | float | mag |  | 1-sigma uncertainty in magapbig |
| `rfid` | long |  |  | Processing ID for reference image to facilitate archive retrieval |
| `magpsf_corr` | float | mag |  | Corrected PSF magnitude accounting for flux in reference image |
| `sigmapsf_corr` | float | mag |  | Error of the corrected PSF magnitude assuming no contribution from an extended component |
| `sigmapsf_corr_ext` | float | mag |  | Error of the corrected PSF magnitude assuming a contribution from an extended component |
| `corrected` | boolean |  |  | Whether the corrected photometry was applied (True if source present in reference image within 1.4 arcsec) |
| `dubious` | boolean |  |  | Whether the corrected photometry should be flagged as dubious due to inconsistencies |
| `parent_candid` | long |  |  | Parent candidate ID if alert coming from previous candidate history (null if from main alert) |
| `has_stamp` | boolean |  |  | Whether the detection has an associated image stamp triplet (when parent_candid is null) |
| `created_date` | char[*] |  |  | Date record was created |

## ztf_non_detection

ZTF non-detection upper limits providing 5-sigma magnitude limits from difference images when an object was not detected, useful for constraining object brightness and variability.

| column | type | unit | flags | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `oid` | long |  | PK IDX TAP | Unique identifier for this object |
| `band` | short |  |  | Filter ID: 1=g, 2=r, 3=i |
| `mjd` | double | d | PK TAP | Observation Modified Julian Date at start of exposure when non-detection occurred |
| `diffmaglim` | float | mag |  | 5-sigma magnitude limit in difference image based on PSF-fit photometry, providing upper limit for object brightness |
| `created_date` | char[*] |  |  | Date record was created |

## ztf_dataquality

Detailed data quality metrics for ZTF detections including image position, PSF-fit quality (chi-square, FWHM), SExtractor properties, pixel statistics, photometric calibration parameters, and signal-to-noise measurements.

| column | type | unit | flags | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `oid` | long |  | PK IDX TAP | Unique identifier for this object |
| `measurement_id` | long |  | PK IDX TAP | Unique identifier for the subtraction candidate |
| `xpos` | float | pix |  | X-image position of candidate on CCD |
| `ypos` | float | pix |  | Y-image position of candidate on CCD |
| `chipsf` | float |  |  | Reduced chi-square for PSF-fit |
| `sky` | float |  |  | Local sky background estimate [DN] |
| `fwhm` | float | pix |  | Full Width Half Maximum assuming a Gaussian core, from SExtractor |
| `classtar` | float |  |  | Star/Galaxy classification score from SExtractor |
| `mindtoedge` | float | pix |  | Distance to nearest edge in image |
| `seeratio` | float |  |  | Ratio: difffwhm / fwhm |
| `aimage` | float | pix |  | Windowed profile RMS along major axis from SExtractor |
| `bimage` | float | pix |  | Windowed profile RMS along minor axis from SExtractor |
| `aimagerat` | float |  |  | Ratio: aimage / fwhm |
| `bimagerat` | float |  |  | Ratio: bimage / fwhm |
| `nneg` | int |  |  | Number of negative pixels in a 5 x 5 pixel stamp |
| `nbad` | int |  |  | Number of prior-tagged bad pixels in a 5 x 5 pixel stamp |
| `sumrat` | float |  |  | Ratio: sum(pixels) / sum(abs(pixels)) in a 5 x 5 pixel stamp where stamp is first median-filtered to mitigate outliers |
| `scorr` | double |  |  | Peak-pixel signal-to-noise ratio in point source matched-filtered detection image |
| `dsnrms` | float |  |  | Ratio: D/stddev(D) on event position where D = difference image |
| `ssnrms` | float |  |  | Ratio: S/stddev(S) on event position where S = image of convolution: D (x) PSF(D) |
| `magzpsci` | float | mag |  | Magnitude zero point for photometry estimates |
| `magzpsciunc` | float | mag |  | Magnitude zero point uncertainty (in magzpsci) |
| `magzpscirms` | float | mag |  | RMS (deviation from average) in all differences between instrumental photometry and matched photometric calibrators from science image processing |
| `nmatches` | int |  |  | Number of PS1 photometric calibrators used to calibrate science image from science image processing |
| `clrcoeff` | float |  |  | Color coefficient from linear fit from photometric calibration of science image |
| `clrcounc` | float |  |  | Color coefficient uncertainty from linear fit (corresponding to clrcoeff) |
| `zpclrcov` | float |  |  | Covariance in magzpsci and clrcoeff from science image processing [mag^2] |
| `zpmed` | float | mag |  | Magnitude zero point from median of all differences between instrumental photometry and matched photometric calibrators from science image processing |
| `clrmed` | float |  |  | Median color of all PS1 photometric calibrators used from science image processing: for filter (fid) = 1, 2, 3, PS1 color used = g-r, g-r, r-i respectively |
| `clrrms` | float |  |  | RMS color (deviation from average) of all PS1 photometric calibrators used from science image processing |
| `exptime` | float | s |  | Integration time of camera exposure |
| `created_date` | char[*] |  |  | Date record was created |

## ztf_reference

Information about ZTF reference (template) images used for difference imaging, including properties of the nearest catalog source, temporal coverage of the reference image stack, and field/CCD identifiers.

| column | type | unit | flags | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `oid` | long |  | PK IDX TAP | Unique identifier for this object |
| `rfid` | long |  | PK TAP | Processing ID for reference image to facilitate archive retrieval |
| `measurement_id` | long |  |  | Unique identifier for the first detection associated with this reference image |
| `band` | int |  |  | Filter ID: 1=g, 2=r, 3=i |
| `rcid` | int |  |  | Readout channel ID [00 .. 63] |
| `field` | int |  |  | ZTF field ID |
| `magnr` | float | mag |  | Magnitude of nearest source in reference image PSF-catalog within 30 arcsec |
| `sigmagnr` | float | mag |  | 1-sigma uncertainty in magnr within 30 arcsec |
| `chinr` | float |  |  | DAOPhot chi parameter of nearest source in reference image PSF-catalog within 30 arcsec |
| `sharpnr` | float |  |  | DAOPhot sharp parameter of nearest source in reference image PSF-catalog within 30 arcsec (values between -0.13 and 0.1 indicate unresolved sources) |
| `ranr` | double | deg |  | Right ascension of nearest source in reference image PSF-catalog, J2000 |
| `decnr` | double | deg |  | Declination of nearest source in reference image PSF-catalog, J2000 |
| `mjdstartref` | double | d |  | Observation Modified Julian Date of earliest exposure used to generate reference image |
| `mjdendref` | double | d |  | Observation Modified Julian Date of latest exposure used to generate reference image |
| `nframesref` | int |  |  | Number of frames (epochal images) used to generate reference image |
| `created_date` | char[*] |  |  | Date record was created |

## ztf_ps1

Cross-match of ZTF detections to Pan-STARRS1 catalog sources within 30 arcsec, including up to three closest matches with multi-band PSF photometry (g, r, i, z), star/galaxy scores, and angular separations.

| column | type | unit | flags | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `oid` | long |  | PK IDX TAP | Unique identifier for this object |
| `measurement_id` | long |  | PK TAP | Unique identifier for the subtraction candidate |
| `objectidps1` | long |  |  | Object ID of closest source from PS1 catalog, if exists within 30 arcsec |
| `sgmag1` | float | mag |  | g-band PSF magnitude of closest source from PS1 catalog, if exists within 30 arcsec |
| `srmag1` | float | mag |  | r-band PSF magnitude of closest source from PS1 catalog, if exists within 30 arcsec |
| `simag1` | float | mag |  | i-band PSF magnitude of closest source from PS1 catalog, if exists within 30 arcsec |
| `szmag1` | float | mag |  | z-band PSF magnitude of closest source from PS1 catalog, if exists within 30 arcsec |
| `sgscore1` | float |  |  | Star/Galaxy score of closest source from PS1 catalog, 0 <= sgscore <= 1 where closer to 1 implies higher likelihood of being a star |
| `distpsnr1` | float | arcsec |  | Distance of closest source from PS1 catalog, if exists within 30 arcsec |
| `objectidps2` | long |  |  | Object ID of second closest source from PS1 catalog, if exists within 30 arcsec |
| `sgmag2` | float | mag |  | g-band PSF magnitude of second closest source from PS1 catalog, if exists within 30 arcsec |
| `srmag2` | float | mag |  | r-band PSF magnitude of second closest source from PS1 catalog, if exists within 30 arcsec |
| `simag2` | float | mag |  | i-band PSF magnitude of second closest source from PS1 catalog, if exists within 30 arcsec |
| `szmag2` | float | mag |  | z-band PSF magnitude of second closest source from PS1 catalog, if exists within 30 arcsec |
| `sgscore2` | float |  |  | Star/Galaxy score of second closest source from PS1 catalog, if exists within 30 arcsec: 0 <= sgscore <= 1 where closer to 1 implies higher likelihood of being a star |
| `distpsnr2` | float | arcsec |  | Distance to second closest source from PS1 catalog, if exists within 30 arcsec |
| `objectidps3` | long |  |  | Object ID of third closest source from PS1 catalog, if exists within 30 arcsec |
| `sgmag3` | float | mag |  | g-band PSF magnitude of third closest source from PS1 catalog, if exists within 30 arcsec |
| `srmag3` | float | mag |  | r-band PSF magnitude of third closest source from PS1 catalog, if exists within 30 arcsec |
| `simag3` | float | mag |  | i-band PSF magnitude of third closest source from PS1 catalog, if exists within 30 arcsec |
| `szmag3` | float | mag |  | z-band PSF magnitude of third closest source from PS1 catalog, if exists within 30 arcsec |

| `distpsnr3` | float | arcsec |  | Distance to third closest source from PS1 catalog, if exists within 30 arcsec |
| `nmtchps` | int |  |  | Number of source matches from PS1 catalog falling within 30 arcsec |
| `created_date` | char[*] |  |  | Date record was created |

## ztf_gaia

Cross-match of ZTF objects to Gaia DR1 catalog sources within 90 arcsec, providing distances and G-band magnitudes for the nearest source and nearest bright source (G < 14 mag).

| column | type | unit | flags | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `oid` | long |  | PK TAP | Unique identifier for this object |
| `measurement_id` | long |  |  | Unique identifier for the subtraction candidate |
| `neargaia` | float | arcsec |  | Distance to closest source from Gaia DR1 catalog irrespective of magnitude, if exists within 90 arcsec |
| `neargaiabright` | float | arcsec |  | Distance to closest source from Gaia DR1 catalog brighter than magnitude 14, if exists within 90 arcsec |
| `maggaia` | float | mag |  | Gaia (G-band) magnitude of closest source from Gaia DR1 catalog irrespective of magnitude, if exists within 90 arcsec |
| `maggaiabright` | float | mag |  | Gaia (G-band) magnitude of closest source from Gaia DR1 catalog brighter than magnitude 14, if exists within 90 arcsec |
| `created_date` | char[*] |  |  | Date record was created |

## lsst_detection

Individual LSST Difference Image Analysis sources, containing detailed measurements from difference imaging including PSF photometry, aperture photometry, trail and dipole fitting for moving objects, shape moments, forced photometry on science and template images, and extensive quality flags for pixels and measurements.

| column | type | unit | flags | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `oid` | long |  | PK IDX TAP | Object identifier |
| `sid` | short |  |  | Survey identifier |
| `measurement_id` | long |  | PK TAP | Unique identifier of this DiaSource |
| `parentdiasourceid` | long |  |  | Id of the parent diaSource this diaSource has been deblended from, if any |
| `visit` | long |  |  | Visit number |
| `detector` | int |  |  | Detector number |
| `diaobjectid` | long |  |  | Id of the diaObject this source was associated with, if any. If not, it is set to NULL (each diaSource will be associated with either a diaObject or ssObject) |
| `ssobjectid` | long |  |  | Id of the ssObject this source was associated with, if any. If not, it is set to NULL (each diaSource will be associated with either a diaObject or ssObject) |
| `raerr` | float | deg |  | Uncertainty of ra |
| `decerr` | float | deg |  | Uncertainty of dec |
| `ra_dec_cov` | float | deg**2 |  | Covariance between ra and dec |
| `x` | float | pix |  | x position computed by a centroiding algorithm |
| `xerr` | float | pix |  | Uncertainty of x |
| `y` | float | pix |  | y position computed by a centroiding algorithm |
| `yerr` | float | pix |  | Uncertainty of y |
| `centroid_flag` | boolean |  |  | General centroid algorithm failure flag; set if anything went wrong when fitting the centroid. Another centroid flag field should also be set to provide more information |
| `apflux` | float |  |  | Flux in a 12 pixel radius aperture on the difference image |
| `apfluxerr` | float |  |  | Estimated uncertainty of apFlux |
| `apflux_flag` | boolean |  |  | General aperture flux algorithm failure flag; set if anything went wrong when measuring aperture fluxes. Another apFlux flag field should also be set to provide more information |
| `apflux_flag_aperturetruncated` | boolean |  |  | Aperture did not fit within measurement image |
| `isnegative` | boolean |  |  | Source was detected as significantly negative |
| `snr` | float |  |  | The signal-to-noise ratio at which this source was detected in the difference image |
| `psfflux` | float |  |  | Flux for Point Source model. Note this actually measures the flux difference between the template and the visit image |
| `psffluxerr` | float |  |  | Uncertainty of psfFlux |
| `psflnl` | float |  |  | Natural log likelihood of the observed data given the point source model |
| `psfchi2` | float |  |  | Chi^2 statistic of the point source model fit |
| `psfndata` | int |  |  | The number of data points (pixels) used to fit the point source model |
| `psfflux_flag` | boolean |  |  | Failure to derive linear least-squares fit of psf model. Another psfFlux flag field should also be set to provide more information |
| `psfflux_flag_edge` | boolean |  |  | Object was too close to the edge of the image to use the full PSF model |
| `psfflux_flag_nogoodpixels` | boolean |  |  | Not enough non-rejected pixels in data to attempt the fit |
| `trailflux` | float |  |  | Flux for a trailed source model. Note this actually measures the flux difference between the template and the visit image |
| `trailfluxerr` | float |  |  | Uncertainty of trailFlux |
| `trailra` | double | deg |  | Right ascension coordinate of centroid for trailed source model |
| `trailraerr` | float | deg |  | Uncertainty of trailRa |
| `traildec` | double | deg |  | Declination coordinate of centroid for trailed source model |
| `traildecerr` | float | deg |  | Uncertainty of trailDec |
| `traillength` | float | arcsec |  | Maximum likelihood fit of trail length |
| `traillengtherr` | float | arcsec |  | Uncertainty of trailLength |
| `trailangle` | float | deg |  | Maximum likelihood fit of the angle between the meridian through the centroid and the trail direction (bearing) |
| `trailangleerr` | float | deg |  | Uncertainty of trailAngle |
| `trailchi2` | float |  |  | Chi^2 statistic of the trailed source model fit |
| `trailndata` | int |  |  | The number of data points (pixels) used to fit the trailed source model |
| `trailalgorithm` | int |  |  | Which algorithm measured the trailed source (1 = SDSSShape, 2 = HSMShape) |
| `trail_flag` | boolean |  |  | This flag is set if trailed-source fitting failed |
| `trail_flag_edge` | boolean |  |  | This flag is set if a trailed source extends onto or past edge pixels |
| `dipolemeanflux` | float |  |  | Maximum likelihood value for the mean absolute flux of the two lobes for a dipole model |
| `dipolemeanfluxerr` | float |  |  | Uncertainty of dipoleMeanFlux |
| `dipolefluxdiff` | float |  |  | Maximum likelihood value for the difference of absolute fluxes of the two lobes for a dipole model |
| `dipolefluxdifferr` | float |  |  | Uncertainty of dipoleFluxDiff |
| `dipolelength` | float | arcsec |  | Maximum likelihood value for the lobe separation in dipole model |
| `dipoleangle` | float | deg |  | Maximum likelihood fit of the angle between the meridian through the centroid and the dipole direction (bearing, from negative to positive lobe) |
| `dipolechi2` | float |  |  | Chi^2 statistic of the model fit |
| `dipolendata` | int |  |  | The number of data points (pixels) used to fit the model |
| `scienceflux` | float |  |  | Forced photometry flux for a point source model measured on the visit image centered at DiaSource position |
| `sciencefluxerr` | float |  |  | Estimated uncertainty of scienceFlux |
| `forced_psfflux_flag` | boolean |  |  | Forced PSF photometry on science image failed. Another forced_PsfFlux flag field should also be set to provide more information |
| `forced_psfflux_flag_edge` | boolean |  |  | Forced PSF flux on science image was too close to the edge of the image to use the full PSF model |
| `forced_psfflux_flag_nogoodpixels` | boolean |  |  | Forced PSF flux not enough non-rejected pixels in data to attempt the fit |
| `templateflux` | float |  |  | Forced photometry flux for a point source model measured on the template image centered at the DiaObject position |
| `templatefluxerr` | float |  |  | Uncertainty of templateFlux |
| `ixx` | float | nJy.arcsec**2 |  | Adaptive second moment of the source intensity |
| `iyy` | float | nJy.arcsec**2 |  | Adaptive second moment of the source intensity |
| `ixy` | float | nJy.arcsec**2 |  | Adaptive second moment of the source intensity |
| `ixxpsf` | float | nJy.arcsec**2 |  | Adaptive second moment for the PSF |
| `iyypsf` | float | nJy.arcsec**2 |  | Adaptive second moment for the PSF |
| `ixypsf` | float | nJy.arcsec**2 |  | Adaptive second moment for the PSF |
| `shape_flag` | boolean |  |  | General source shape algorithm failure flag; set if anything went wrong when measuring the shape. Another shape flag field should also be set to provide more information |
| `shape_flag_no_pixels` | boolean |  |  | No pixels to measure shape |
| `shape_flag_not_contained` | boolean |  |  | Center not contained in footprint bounding box |
| `shape_flag_parent_source` | boolean |  |  | This source is a parent source; we should only be measuring on deblended children in difference imaging |
| `extendedness` | float |  |  | A measure of extendedness, computed by comparing an object's moment-based traced radius to the PSF moments. extendedness = 1 implies a high degree of confidence that the source is extended. extendedness = 0 implies a high degree of confidence that the source is point-like |
| `reliability` | float |  |  | Probability (0-1) that the diaSource is astrophysical, derived from a machine learning model |
| `reliabilityversion` | char[*] |  |  | Version of the reliability (real/bogus) model used to compute reliability |
| `isdipole` | boolean |  |  | Source well fit by a dipole |
| `dipolefitattempted` | boolean |  |  | Attempted to fit a dipole model to this source |
| `timeprocessedmjdtai` | double | d |  | Time when the image was processed and this DiaSource record was generated, expressed as Modified Julian Date, International Atomic Time |
| `timewithdrawnmjdtai` | double | d |  | Time when this record was marked invalid, expressed as Modified Julian Date, International Atomic Time |
| `exposuretime` | float | s |  | Effective exposure time for the diaSource |
| `bboxsize` | int | pix |  | Size of the square bounding box that fully contains the detection footprint |
| `pixelflags` | boolean |  |  | General pixel flags failure; set if anything went wrong when setting pixels flags from this footprint's mask. This implies that some pixelFlags for this source may be incorrectly set to False |
| `pixelflags_bad` | boolean |  |  | Bad pixel in the DiaSource footprint |
| `pixelflags_cr` | boolean |  |  | Cosmic ray in the DiaSource footprint |
| `pixelflags_crcenter` | boolean |  |  | Cosmic ray in the 3x3 region around the centroid |
| `pixelflags_edge` | boolean |  |  | Some of the source footprint is outside usable exposure region (masked EDGE or centroid off image) |
| `pixelflags_nodata` | boolean |  |  | NO_DATA pixel in the source footprint |
| `pixelflags_nodatacenter` | boolean |  |  | NO_DATA pixel in the 3x3 region around the centroid |
| `pixelflags_interpolated` | boolean |  |  | Interpolated pixel in the DiaSource footprint |
| `pixelflags_interpolatedcenter` | boolean |  |  | Interpolated pixel in the 3x3 region around the centroid |
| `pixelflags_offimage` | boolean |  |  | DiaSource center is off image |
| `pixelflags_saturated` | boolean |  |  | Saturated pixel in the DiaSource footprint |
| `pixelflags_saturatedcenter` | boolean |  |  | Saturated pixel in the 3x3 region around the centroid |
| `pixelflags_suspect` | boolean |  |  | DiaSource's footprint includes suspect pixels |
| `pixelflags_suspectcenter` | boolean |  |  | Suspect pixel in the 3x3 region around the centroid |
| `pixelflags_streak` | boolean |  |  | Streak in the DiaSource footprint |
| `pixelflags_streakcenter` | boolean |  |  | Streak in the 3x3 region around the centroid |
| `pixelflags_injected` | boolean |  |  | Injection in the DiaSource footprint |
| `pixelflags_injectedcenter` | boolean |  |  | Injection in the 3x3 region around the centroid |
| `pixelflags_injected_template` | boolean |  |  | Template injection in the DiaSource footprint |
| `pixelflags_injected_templatecenter` | boolean |  |  | Template injection in the 3x3 region around the centroid |
| `glint_trail` | boolean |  |  | This flag is set if the source is part of a glint trail |
| `has_stamp` | boolean |  |  | Has image stamp flag |
| `created_date` | char[*] |  |  | Date record was created |

| `psffluxerr` | float |  |  | Uncertainty of psfFlux |
| `scienceflux` | float |  |  | Forced photometry flux for a point source model measured on the visit image centered at the DiaObject position |

## lsst_ss_detection

Individual LSST detections associated with solar system objects, including observing geometry (phase angle, elongation, ranges), ephemeris predictions, ephemeris offsets (O-C residuals), and heliocentric/topocentric state vectors in ICRS coordinates.

| column | type | unit | flags | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `measurement_id` | long |  | PK TAP | Unique identifier of this DIA source observation |
| `ssobjectid` | long |  | PK IDX TAP | LSST solar system object identifier |
| `designation` | char[*] |  |  | Unpacked primary provisional designation for this solar system object |
| `ecllambda` | double | deg |  | Ecliptic longitude |
| `eclbeta` | double | deg |  | Ecliptic latitude |
| `gallon` | double | deg |  | Galactic longitude |
| `gallat` | double | deg |  | Galactic latitude |
| `elongation` | float | deg |  | Solar elongation, the angular separation of the object from the Sun on the celestial sphere |
| `phaseangle` | float | deg |  | Phase angle, the angle between the Sun and observer as seen from the object |
| `toporange` | float | AU |  | Topocentric range, the distance from the observer to the object |
| `toporangerate` | float | AU/d |  | Topocentric range rate, the radial velocity of the object relative to the observer |
| `heliorange` | float | AU |  | Heliocentric range, the distance from the Sun to the object |
| `heliorangerate` | float | AU/d |  | Heliocentric range rate, the radial velocity of the object relative to the Sun |
| `ephra` | double | deg |  | Predicted ICRS right ascension computed from orbit propagation at observation time |
| `ephdec` | double | deg |  | Predicted ICRS declination computed from orbit propagation at observation time |
| `ephvmag` | float | mag |  | Predicted V-band magnitude computed from orbit propagation at observation time |
| `ephrate` | float | arcsec/h |  | Predicted total angular rate of motion on the sky |
| `ephratera` | float | arcsec/h |  | Predicted angular rate of motion along right ascension |
| `ephratedec` | float | arcsec/h |  | Predicted angular rate of motion along declination |
| `ephoffset` | float | arcsec |  | Total angular offset between observed and predicted position on the celestial sphere |
| `ephoffsetra` | double | deg |  | Angular offset in right ascension between observed and predicted position (observed minus predicted) |
| `ephoffsetdec` | double | deg |  | Angular offset in declination between observed and predicted position (observed minus predicted) |
| `ephoffsetalongtrack` | float | arcsec |  | Angular offset along the direction of motion between observed and predicted position |
| `ephoffsetcrosstrack` | float | arcsec |  | Angular offset perpendicular to the direction of motion between observed and predicted position |
| `helio_x` | float | AU |  | Heliocentric X position component in ICRS reference frame |
| `helio_y` | float | AU |  | Heliocentric Y position component in ICRS reference frame |
| `helio_z` | float | AU |  | Heliocentric Z position component in ICRS reference frame |
| `helio_vx` | float | AU/d |  | Heliocentric velocity component along X axis in ICRS reference frame |
| `helio_vy` | float | AU/d |  | Heliocentric velocity component along Y axis in ICRS reference frame |
| `helio_vz` | float | AU/d |  | Heliocentric velocity component along Z axis in ICRS reference frame |
| `helio_vtot` | float | AU/d |  | Heliocentric total velocity magnitude |
| `topo_x` | float | AU |  | Topocentric X position component in ICRS reference frame relative to the observer |
| `topo_y` | float | AU |  | Topocentric Y position component in ICRS reference frame relative to the observer |
| `topo_z` | float | AU |  | Topocentric Z position component in ICRS reference frame relative to the observer |
| `topo_vx` | float | AU/d |  | Topocentric velocity component along X axis in ICRS reference frame |
| `topo_vy` | float | AU/d |  | Topocentric velocity component along Y axis in ICRS reference frame |
| `topo_vz` | float | AU/d |  | Topocentric velocity component along Z axis in ICRS reference frame |
| `topo_vtot` | float | AU/d |  | Topocentric total velocity magnitude |
| `diadistancerank` | int |  |  | Ranking based on the distance between this DIA source and the predicted position of the solar system object, with 1 being the closest match |
| `created_date` | char[*] |  |  | Date record was created |
